source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: Subjects of both finite (101) and non-finite (102) clausal complements can be marked either nominative or accusative. The two types of embedded sentences will be referred to as dien-clauses and KP-clauses, respectively.
en: I heard that you won today.
